diagnostic_rule.capacity: Trapezoidal integral of negative current over time within each cycle, accepting time steps from 0 through 120 seconds.
diagnostic_rule.initial_reference: First operation with integrated discharge capacity above 1e-6 Ah.
diagnostic_rule.later_cycle_eligibility: Integrated discharge capacity at least 0.10 times the same cell's initial reference capacity.
diagnostic_rule.selection: Latest eligible cycle in each operation block.
diagnostic_rule.countercheck: Retain disagreement above 2% versus within-cycle Discharge_Ah range.
